searchText: Hi all, Given that the HF for Goerli is happening on the 14th, do we know if there is a requirement on the minimum versions we need to be at for geth and lighthhouse? Yes. But those clients are not released yet. Pay attention to e.g. their respective release channels on Discord, they will explicitly mention Goerli Thanks. could you pls point me to what the release channels are for geth and lightouse? I didnt see any specific to those. Well, you can follow the announcement channel on EthStaker discord (which relays those messages), or the Geth and Lighthouse discords Hope these still work: https://discord.gg/gdq27tnKSM (Lighthouse) https://discord.com/invite/nthXNEv (Geth) https://discord.io/ethstaker (EthStaker, follow the #client-updates channel there)
